props.title: Nimbus X Launch Event: Live Blog
props.subtitle: Updates from the keynote, newest first

props.title: Live now
props.description: The event is wrapping up. Pricing and availability have just been announced.

props.title: 11:42 AM · Pricing and availability
props.details: Nimbus X starts at $799. Preorders open today, shipping begins March 14 in 20 countries.

props.title: 11:25 AM · Battery life
props.details: Rated for up to 22 hours of mixed use, with 70% charge in 30 minutes via the new 65W adapter.

props.title: 11:08 AM · Live demo of Nimbus Assist
props.details: The on-device assistant summarized a 40-page document in under five seconds, running fully offline.

props.title: 10:49 AM · Camera system unveiled
props.details: A new 50MP triple-camera array with improved low-light performance and 8K video recording.

props.title: 10:31 AM · Meet the Nimbus X
props.details: A 6.4-inch display, a titanium frame, and a 30% faster custom chip. Weighs just 168 grams.

props.title: 10:00 AM · Keynote begins
props.details: CEO Maya Ortiz takes the stage and welcomes attendees to the Nimbus launch event.
